nigeria_market_note: Nigeria’s parallel ranges combine two independent current-day observations dated 30 Oct (one updated 08:11 WAT and one with time not shown), rechecked at 12:28 WAT. The full observed ranges are preserved rather than forcing a single quote. CBN benchmark rates are those of 29 Oct, the latest posted. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources.
method: premium_pct = (parallel buying midpoint / CBN selling rate - 1) x 100
